command: fresh cluster; mth-db migrate; mth-db seed-demo; mth-db seed-dev; API and worker at http://localhost:25301; deploy/scripts/smoke.mjs (MTH_SMOKE_AUTH=dev); journey.mjs --mode dev --steps signin,uploads
DATABASE_OWNER_URL=<S> node tools/migration/export.mjs --out <work>/package --operator 'transfer-drill synthetic operator' (attachments.json count = S's rows with a storage_key)

node deploy/scripts/generate-env-example.mjs --check && node deploy/scripts/drill/config-trace.mjs --template .env.example --guide docs/handover/deployment.md --map deploy/scripts/drill/guide-keys.json
mth-db migrate && mth-db bootstrap (twice; the second must refuse) on a separate clean database

node tools/migration/prepare-target.mjs --from <package> && node tools/migration/import.mjs --from <package> --operator 'transfer-drill synthetic operator' --keep-reports <out>/import-reports --manifest-sha256 <hex> && node tools/migration/reconcile.mjs --operator 'transfer-drill synthetic operator' --from <package> (mode 1)

mth-db rebind-identity --mapping <mapping.csv> --operator 'transfer-drill synthetic operator' (one carried user left unmapped); node tools/migration/reconcile.mjs --from <package> (mode 1, rebind delta)

start the drill IdP, the API and the worker from the runtime tree with target.env; GET /readyz until 200, storage ok, worker alive (120 s); journey.mjs --steps signin,status (getDeploymentStatus origin and environmentKind)

node deploy/scripts/drill/journey.mjs --mode oidc-drill --app http://127.0.0.1:25302 --source-origin http://localhost:25301 (signin, unbound, csrf, status, writes, approve, downloads, deeplink; keys into journal.json)

stop worker; journey exportq; job-check snapshot; stop API, PostgreSQL; start PostgreSQL, API, worker; job-check compare; journey exportwait, downloads; allowance.mjs; node tools/migration/reconcile.mjs --from <package> --after-use --allow <allowance.json> (mode 2)
